sources.title: YuhengSSS/SDRPN-Gemma-4-12B - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SD-RPN stage-1 checkpoint: a self-distilled RoI predictor twig (K = 27, T = 3) trained on a frozen, encoder-free google/gemma-4-12B-it. This is the initialisation of the Vision-RL² RL run YuhengSSS/VisionRL2-Gemma-4-12B.
